subject: Culture
title: Religious Vestments
description: Learn Religious Vestments in one minute.

hook.text: A Catholic priest in full vestments wears seven separate garments, each representing a theological virtue.

buildup.text: Religious clothing separates the sacred from the mundane. Putting on vestments transforms a person into a role.

discovery.text: Buddhist monks wear saffron robes made from discarded cloth. The color and simplicity signal renunciation.

twist.text: Sikh turbans aren't fashion—they are articles of faith. Removing one in public is considered deeply disrespectful.

climax.text: Secular societies struggle with religious dress: freedom of expression clashes with demands for visual conformity.

punchline.text: Sacred clothing is faith you can see.

quiz.question: Why do Buddhist monks traditionally wear saffron?
